h2-gated-forgetting-ablation.name: H2 (v3 §9): gated vs uniform vs no forgetting under matched storage budget

conditions.name: gated
conditions.description: DEFAULT_GATING — content-salience-driven durability (important memories decay slower)

conditions.name: uniform
conditions.description: NO_GATING — identity gate, all durability=1, decay uniform

conditions.name: none
conditions.description: No forgetting (baseDecay=0) — truncation degrades to keep-most-recent

h2-gated-forgetting-ablation.notes: Budgets [10%,25%,50%]; horizon +90d; TOP_K=4. Re-frame (commit 0683600): gate is content-salience driven, deterministic per (cond, budget) — former physiological-seed dimension removed. Falsifiable prediction: gated > uniform, gap widens as budget tightens; else v3 §10 P3 fuse-point triggers.

h2-content-salience-gated.name: H2 de-oracled: predicted (content) salience gated vs uniform under matched storage

conditions.name: gated
conditions.description: DEFAULT_GATING — content-salience-driven durability

conditions.name: uniform
conditions.description: NO_GATING — identity gate, uniform decay

h2-content-salience-gated.notes: Reports predictor quality (pooled + per-conversation AUC) and the gated−uniform recall gap under content-salience gating. Re-frame (commit 0683600): oracle/predicted injection and α-mixing are obsolete; both collapse to the same content-salience gate. Falsifiable: gap still > 0 means the gate uses a predictable signal; gap ≈ 0 means the prior H2 gain was oracle leakage (→ v3 §10 fuse-point).

salience-diagnostic-features.name: Salience diagnostic: which lexical features separate evidence-bearing turns (oracle-label audit)

conditions.name: diagnostic
conditions.description: Oracle-label single-feature AUC audit to choose predictor features; NOT a published result

salience-diagnostic-features.notes: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — uses gold labels to decide which features to add to the predictor. Any label-tuned feature/weight MUST be re-evaluated under leave-one-conversation cross-validation (LOCV) before publication, or the label leaks back in. Not registered as a result.

salience-predictor-probe.name: Salience predictor probe: PRIOR (zero-label) vs LOCV AUC, and the learning curve

conditions.name: PRIOR
conditions.description: Theoretically-prior weights, zero label contact; scale set by unsupervised statistics

conditions.name: LOCV
conditions.description: Leave-one-conversation-out logistic regression (simulates F/U feedback learning weights)

salience-predictor-probe.notes: Seed 7 drives the learning-curve random fold splits (mulberry32(7), 20 trials per k). Both estimates are honest (no label-driven weight tuning). Answers A1: feature vs weight sufficiency — LOCV high & PRIOR low ⇒ features suffice, needs feedback; both low ⇒ need a different signal source. Threshold ≈ 0.78.

salience-nested-cv-audit.name: Salience nested-CV audit: leak decomposition (standardize + feature-selection leakage)

conditions.name: LOCV-original
conditions.description: Global standardize + all 13 features, leave-one-conversation-out (replicates probe.ts)

conditions.name: LOCV-trainStd
conditions.description: Standardize statistics computed on training folds only (fixes standardize leakage)

conditions.name: Nested-Train
conditions.description: Outer LOCV + inner greedy forward feature selection on 9 train conversations (honest pooled AUC)

salience-nested-cv-audit.notes: AUDIT ONLY — quantifies how much of probe.ts LOCV=0.812 is optimistic bias from leakage. All logic copied verbatim from probe.ts for comparability. The Nested-Train pooled AUC is the publishable, honest estimate.

p1.5-reader-qa-f1.notes: Requires local Ollama substrate qwythos:latest in research mode (temperature=0, top_k=1). Two probes: controlled distractor-competition benchmark + small LoCoMo slice.

h5-gated-vs-compression-baseline.name: H5 (v2/P2): content-salience gated memory vs long-context compression baselines (LoCoMo, matched storage budget)

conditions.name: ours
conditions.description: Biomimetic gated selective retention — keep top-B episodes by encoded content salience (DEFAULT_GATING)

conditions.name: extractive-compression
conditions.description: LLM-free global centrality score (0.6·TF-IDF centroid + 0.4·content-salience) top-B (NO_GATING)

conditions.name: recency-window
conditions.description: Keep most-recent B episodes (NO_GATING)

conditions.name: random
conditions.description: Uniform random keep-B, 5 deterministic seeds averaged (NO_GATING)

h5-gated-vs-compression-baseline.notes: Budgets [10%,25%,50%,100%]; TOP_K=4. (A) Full lexical recall/F1 proxy over all questions. (B) Answer-correctness layer on a sampled subset (~17 q/conv, local qwythos) with token-F1 + LLM-judge — latency-driven sampling, stated as caveat. Falsifiable: ours should beat recency at low budget and converge to ~0 gap as B→1.0; whether ours beats the stronger compression baseline is the core question (not guaranteed).
